title: Wave and Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the charming Seacrest Beach community, this stunning three-story coastal retreat offers the ideal blend of relaxation and recreation for your 30A vacation. Featuring four thoughtfully designed bedrooms, including a convenient main-floor master suite and a delightful upstairs bunk room that sleeps four, this home is perfectly suited for families of all sizes, including multi-generational gatherings. The loft’s game area adds a fun touch, ensuring entertainment for everyone. After a sun-soaked day at the beach, unwind on the upstairs porch swing or gather in the spacious living room to cheer on your favorite team, creating memories to last a lifetime. Every detail of this home has been curated with your comfort and convenience in mind. From its welcoming design to its unbeatable location, you’ll have everything you need for a seamless and enjoyable stay. Located just moments from the best of 30A, including pristine beaches, local dining, and boutique shopping, it’s the perfect setting for both relaxation and adventure. Whether you’re savoring quiet mornings with coffee on the porch or exploring the vibrant surroundings, this home promises an unforgettable coastal getaway.
